blogs.title: Breaking the Speedlimit: How FlashAttention-3 Pipes Attention Like a Marathon
blogs.description: Explore the innovation of 'Producer-Consumer asynchrony.' This post demystifies how FlashAttention-3 uses warp-specialization to split data movement from computation, turning the CPU-like wait states of AI inference into a high-speed-overlap pipeline similar to lane changes in a race.

blogs.title: The Secret to FP8's Accuracy: Why Your Model Isn't Losing Memory
blogs.description: AI practitioners often fear 8-bit precision (FP8) due to rounding errors. Dive into the 'Block Quantization' and 'Incoherent Processing' techniques that act like a smart filter, spreading out outliers mathematically so that high-speed, low-precision calculation stays accurate for Long-term Context models.

blogs.title: Hiding Softmax in the Output: The 2-Staged Efficiency Hack
blogs.description: Since exponentials and matmul operations run at vastly different speeds, standard code creates bottlenecks. Learn how FlashAttention-3 intelligently overcomes this by overlapping the non-GEMM softmax calculation with the next block's matrix multiplication, achieving up to 740 TFLOPS.
